description: This file defines the 'ObservableGrain' class, which is a grain implementation for Orleans, implementing interfaces 'IObservableGrain' and 'IIncomingGrainCallFilter'. It contains methods for streaming data, error simulation, activation control, and logging incoming calls.

classes.name: ObservableGrain
classes.description: A grain class that supports streaming data and call logging, implementing interfaces for observable patterns and incoming call filtering.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns an async stream of string messages from the internal channel.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Produces an infinite sequence of integers, throwing an error at a specified index, optionally canceling.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the updates channel, signaling no more data will be sent.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Completes the updates channel with an exception to simulate failure.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain by invoking Orleans' deactivation method.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Writes a data string asynchronously to the updates channel.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of interface and method names for incoming calls received by this grain.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Logs the incoming call's interface and method name, then proceeds with invocation.
